notes:
RoHelper 0.8.0

Export and import individual macros as JSON files or compressed RHM1 share codes.
Codes preserve Lua and visual blocks with checksums and bounded decoding.
Review imports before saving; fresh IDs prevent overwriting existing macros.
Record keyboard and mouse input from one selected Roblox client, with F8 to stop.
Mouse recording uses the selected 3x3 origin and current client dimensions at each event.
Editable mouse movement supports recorded drags; holds and timing are preserved.
Recording stays in memory until saved. Account data remains in Local AppData.
